from mcp import ClientSession
from mcp.client.streamable_http import streamablehttp_client
import mcp_helper

async def q(stmt):
    url = mcp_helper.SERVERS["sql"]
    async with streamablehttp_client(url) as (r, w, _):
        async with ClientSession(r, w) as s:
            await s.initialize()
            res = await s.call_tool("execute_sql_statement", {"catalog": "[name]", "statement": stmt, "wait_timeout": "30s", "row_limit": 5000})
            texts = [c.text for c in res.content if hasattr(c, 'text')]
            obj = json.loads(texts[0]) if texts else None
            if isinstance(obj, dict) and obj.get("result"):
                return obj["result"].get("data_array", [])
            return [obj]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    rows = asyncio.run(q(sys.argv[1]))
    for r in rows:
